evals.prompt: Reshape MDE /rentals into a desktop and mobile discovery workspace with filters, ranked cards, a map and persistent Ask MDE. Preserve the existing search/map contracts and show loading, empty and error states.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing MDE design system, establishes clear discovery hierarchy and responsive states, keeps AI progress user-facing, and does not invent business truth.

evals.prompt: Design the MDE rental detail experience for desktop and mobile. It needs a photo gallery, grounded Why it fits reasons, availability, location, and a persistent Request viewing action, including missing-photo and unavailable states.
evals.expected_output: Produces intentional visual hierarchy and responsive behavior, explicitly covers degraded states, and treats match reasons and requestability as canonical inputs rather than UI-derived claims.

evals.prompt: Polish the renter viewing-request journey: choose a time, review the request, submit once, then show requested/confirmed/rescheduled/declined status without exposing internal lead terminology.
evals.expected_output: Uses progressive disclosure, clear review/commit boundaries, user-facing language and state-specific UX without implying backend success before confirmation.
